notes: All five views reviewed. Curved irises are clean, straps remain narrow and attached, the chin profile is improved and both shoes have ground contact. Still stylized: eyelid blend, nose anatomy, smile and hair need further work.
history: Iteration 1 / revision 1: 48/100 - Recognizable outfit and pose, but scalp gap, sock intersections, angular face contours, overly smooth ponytails and jagged neckline. Not near 95/100.

Iteration 2 / revision 2: 62/100 - Scalp and sock defects fixed. Four views reviewed. Remaining: visible neck join, stiff hair, narrow face, floating straps and shoe saddle edges; resemblance remains stylized.

Iteration 3 / revision 3: 68/100 - Five views reviewed. Equal-length leg joints, relaxed torso, neck attachment and shoe straps improved. Hair remains too stiff; blouse is too short and the face remains stylized.
Iteration 4 / revision 4: 70/100 - Four views reviewed. Blouse length, waistband height and scalp fit improved. Hair remains overly layered and the face needs more natural eyelids, lips and teeth.

Iteration 5 / revision 5: 72/100 - Five views reviewed. Continuous hair and wavy ponytails are improved. The larger smile exposes jagged face-opening edges; eyelid rims remain artificial. These are the next fixes.

Iteration 6 / revision 6: 72/100 - Five views reviewed. Mouth edge repaired and web export merged to 35 meshes. Eye reflections became too strong, so resemblance score is unchanged. Next: eye glare, smile curvature and fringe shape.

Iteration 7 / revision 7: 73/100 - Five views reviewed. Eye glare reduced and crown rounded. The smile still has too much dark opening; eye spacing, teeth, lips and smiling cheek contours need refinement.

Iteration 8 / revision 8: 74/100 - Five views reviewed. Rounded teeth, lips and softer brows improve the face. Remaining: eyes look too open, hair intersects the shoulder, cloth neckline is artificial, and the leg pose is not yet close enough.

Iteration 9 / revision 9: 76/100 - Five views reviewed. Raised-foot pose, skirt proportions, continuous neckline and hair clearance improved. Lightweight model retains the same main surfaces. Remaining: face still stylized and front backpack straps float from the shirt.
Iteration 10 / revision 10: 73/100 — Rejected in prior session: stepped eyelid boundaries, detached fringe and intersecting straps.
Iteration 11 / revision 11: 75/100 — All five views reviewed in this continuation: cleaner facial joins but excessive chin projection and a raised shoe. Rejected.

Iteration 12 / revision 12: 75/100 — All five views reviewed in this continuation: improved profile and foot contact, but iris fans intersect eye whites and projected straps stretch across the ribs. Rejected.

Iteration 13 / revision 13: 78/100 — All five views reviewed. Curved irises are clean, straps remain narrow and attached, the chin profile is improved and both shoes have ground contact. Still stylized: eyelid blend, nose anatomy, smile and hair need further work.

Iteration 14 / revision 14: 78/100 — Five body views and the facial close-up reviewed. Smoother eyelid transitions and stronger brows are useful, but the new lower-chin transition and dark nostrils are not yet natural enough. Revision 13 remains the published checkpoint.

Iteration 15 / revision 15: 78/100 — Six views reviewed, including a new close facial side view. Eye contrast and nostril size are improved, but the side view exposes an overly hollow collar/neck junction and the lower-chin transition still needs smoothing. The published model stays revision 13.

Iteration 16 / revision 16: 78/100 — Six views reviewed. Curved lapels are better than the flat panels, but the side view reveals that the chest was excluded from the garment-height warp and the tie neck band intersects the collar. These are corrected before promotion.
